interfaces.package: WLCSP-9 or MLP-14 — variant not determined
interfaces.what: TWO PACKAGES SHIP AND THE DESIGN DOES NOT SAY WHICH. The datasheet's own feature list and ordering information give: 9-Ball WLCSP 1.2150 x 1.2600 mm (FUSB302BUCX family, physical dimensions Figure 18, page 33) and 14-Lead MLP 2.5000 x 2.5000 mm on a 0.5000 mm pin pitch (FUSB302MPX, Figure 19, page 34). The frame is the package centre ON THE SEATING PLANE for whichever is fitted. This row records both envelopes rather than picking one: a 1.2 mm CSP and a 2.5 mm MLP are a factor of four apart in area and cannot both be right. What settles it: the Robot HAT board file the PCB lane is producing (electronics/robot-hat/), or a photograph of the fitted part. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN DATASHEET: FUSB302 features/ordering text (page 1) and Physical Dimensions Figure 18 (page 33) and Figure 19 (page 34) of 35 — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf, sha256 in current/PROVENANCE.json), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
